subject.title: refactor(ui): consolidate chat lifecycle regression tests

question: Should this maintainer-labeled chat-test consolidation land after a maintainer confirms that the table-driven cases preserve one-to-one regression traceability and useful failure output?
rationale: The branch is intentionally a broad maintenance refactor of critical regression coverage, and the protected label prevents an automated cleanup or landing decision.

options.title: Review traceability, then land
options.body: Confirm each removed named regression has an equally specific table row or isolated assertion and accept the focused validation evidence.

options.title: Request narrower grouping
options.body: Ask for tables or helpers to be split where a failed parameterized case would obscure the original chat lifecycle scenario.

recommendation.title: Review traceability, then land
recommendation.body: Confirm each removed named regression has an equally specific table row or isolated assertion and accept the focused validation evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This person supplied the proposed consolidation and validation context, making them the clearest available routing contact; current-main ownership history remains unverified.
